verses.1: And in that same place, he also went around the city and the district, preaching and announcing the kingdom of God. And those twelve people went with him.
verses.2: And there were also some women who were cured from the evil spirits and illnesses. Mary, known as Magdalene, was one of them; seven demons were cast out from her.
verses.3: And Joan, the wife of Housha, and Susanna, and many others, who received gifts from those who were around them.
verses.4: He also addressed the crowd, who were many, and those who had traveled to the city to see him. He said this in a joke-like manner.
verses.5: The grain of the wheat was taken away by the wind. And during its flight, it fell along the path it took. It was then caught up by the clouds in the sky and carried away with them.
verses.6: And another one fell onto the rock. It probably died because it had no roots.
verses.7: And another one fell in the middle of the thorns. The thorns inhaled it along with itself.
verses.8: And another one fell into the earth, and it produced a fruit that was one hundred times greater in size. Saying this, he cried out, “May those who have ears listen to this.”
verses.9: But the disciples asked him, “What kind of parable is this?”
verses.10: He said, “We are given the knowledge of the mysteries of God’s kingdom. The rest of us, however, are given these mysteries in a hidden form, so that they cannot be seen or heard by others.”
verses.11: It’s a metaphorical expression. The “seed” represents the word of God.
verses.12: But those who follow along on this path, those who listen to the words, then the devil comes and severs their hearts from believing, so that they cannot be saved.
verses.13: But those who are on the rock, when they hear the word with joy, they do not take it to heart. They believe at the right time, and in time of trial, they stand firm.
verses.14: And those who fall into sin are those who listen to evil words. They are led by greed, wealth, and the pleasures of life, and they never truly repent.
verses.15: But those who are in the right state of mind, they are those who hear the word in their hearts with kindness and goodness, and they also bear fruit through patience.
verses.16: No one covers it with a canopy or something to protect it from the sun. Instead, they place a canopy underneath it, so that those who come along can see the light.
verses.17: For nothing is hidden that does not become visible, and nothing that is not known cannot become apparent.
verses.18: So, see how you listen to this: whoever possesses it will be given it; and whoever does not possess it will be deprived of it. And those who seem to possess it will also be deprived of it.
verses.19: His mother and brothers also came to see him. But they couldn’t get close to him because of the crowd.
verses.20: And he was told, “Your mother and your brothers are outside, wanting to see you.”
verses.21: And the one who answered said to them, “My mother and my brothers are those who listen to God’s words and carry them out.”
verses.22: One day, he also got on the ship, along with his disciples. He said to them, “Let’s go across the lake.” And they set off.
verses.23: Many of them were drowned in the water. The wind blew them down towards the lake, and they were destroyed and lost.
verses.24: But when they came near him, they said to him, “Ephistata, Ephistata!” We will be destroyed. But he, being enraged, threw stones at the wind and the water’s branches. Then the wind stopped, and peace was restored.
verses.25: He said to them, “What is your faith?” They were afraid and marveled at this. They said to each other, “Who could it be who can command the winds and water to obey him?”
verses.26: And they crossed into the land of the Gerassenes, which is located beyond Galilee.
verses.27: When he came out onto the land, a man from the city came to him. This man had demons in him. Over time, he never wore clothes at all; he didn’t stay in houses either, but instead lived in tombs.
verses.28: When he saw Jesus, he rushed up to him and said in a loud voice, “What is my fate, and yours, Jesus, son of the Almighty God? Please do not torture me.”
verses.29: For it was disgusted by the filthy spirit that had to leave the human being. For many years, it was carried along by that spirit; it was tied up with ropes and chains. As it tried to break free from those bonds, it was driven by the demon into the wilderness.
verses.30: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He replied, “My name is Lehi.” Jesus said that many demons had come into him.
verses.31: And they begged him not to allow them to go into the abyss.
verses.32: There was also a flock of ripe sheep that were being herded up the mountain. They asked him to allow them to go there. And he allowed them to do so.
verses.33: When the demons left the man, they entered the sheep. Then, the angel rushed towards the lake and put them to death.
verses.34: Seeing what had happened, the boars fled and ran away to the city and the fields.
verses.35: We went to see what had happened. We came before Jesus. We saw that the man was sitting there, no longer under the influence of demons. He was sitting there, calm and at peace, by Jesus’ feet. They were terrified.
verses.36: And those who were able to see told them how the possessed man was saved.
verses.37: And he asked him whether the entire population of the Gerasian region would leave them; they were too afraid to do so. But he went back into the ship instead.
verses.38: But the man said to him, “You must not let the demons leave you along with you.” Then he dismissed him, saying:
verses.39: Go back to your home, and tell them all what God has done for you. Then go away from the entire city, and tell them about everything that Jesus did for him.
verses.40: But when they tried to throw Jesus off the cliff, the crowd refused to do it. After all, everyone expected them to do so.
verses.41: And behold, a man named James came. He was the leader of the group. When he fell at Jesus’ feet, he begged Him to enter His house.
verses.42: Because she was his only daughter; she lived for twelve years, and then she died. During his illness, the people around him took care of him.
verses.43: And there was also a woman who lived in a place where there was blood from twelve years ago. She went to doctors throughout her life, but she never managed to get any treatment at all.
verses.44: As she approached, he wiped the sweat from her forehead with his hand. Then, the sweat from her body covered his clothes.
verses.45: And Jesus said, “Who is it who is trying to harm me?” When everyone denied it, Peter said, “Truly, they continue to persecute you.”
verses.46: But Jesus said, “Let me go! For I have no power to do this by myself.”
verses.47: When the woman saw that he wasn’t afraid at all, she rushed towards him and explained in front of everyone in the crowd why she had done such a thing. She was extremely angry.
verses.48: And he said to her, “Daughter, your faith has saved you. Go forward towards peace.”
verses.49: While he was still speaking, some people from the head teacher’s group came forward and said that your daughter had died. They no longer wanted to listen to the teacher’s words anymore.
verses.50: But when Jesus heard this, he said to him, “Do not fear; simply believe, and you will be saved.”
verses.51: When he entered the house, he wouldn’t allow anyone else to enter with him, except for Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and the mother.
verses.52: All of them wept and stopped crying about her. But he said, “Do not cry. She has not died, but she is still alive.”
verses.53: And they were also shocked, knowing that he had died.
verses.54: And he held her hand in his own, and said, “Child, I command you.”
verses.55: And her spirit was restored to her. She stood up again, and she was ordered to eat.
verses.56: And her parents also kept quiet about what had happened. He told them not to say anything about it at all.
